_readme: Composition axis single source. until now style-lab was varying the color/typography; This file diversifies the SKELETON. tokens.json → layout.hero / layout.nav have to choose one of the ids here (door: kit/check-layout.mjs). New archetype = register here + kit/render/partials/<id>.html + [data-layout] block in scene.css.

heroes.label: Split
heroes.when: copy on the left, product image on the right; balanced, neutral default

heroes.label: Split (ters)
heroes.when: image on left, copy on right; breaks the flow of reading, rhythm in brave families

heroes.label: centered
heroes.when: single message + wide visual band; quiet, infrequent brands

heroes.label: Pure typography
heroes.when: no visual; the title screen itself. Poster/magazine/agency display

heroes.label: full edge media
heroes.when: media bleeds to the left edge (no card), copy breathes on the right; showcase/luxury

heroes.label: product display
heroes.when: The copy is small at the top, the giant product panel is at the bottom; vehicle claim

heroes.label: index grid
heroes.when: copy narrow on left, 2×2 job/record grid on right; portfolio, archive

heroes.label: sticky narrative
heroes.when: sticky copy on left, scrolling 3-panel story strip on right; long page

navs.label: inline
navs.when: brand + links + two buttons; neutral default

navs.label: floating pill
navs.when: Links in the middle, disconnected from the page; surface/glass and showcase families

navs.label: divided
navs.when: brand on the left, links on the right, single text CTA; editorial and typographic

navs.label: auxiliary line
navs.when: thin helper row at top, main navigation at bottom; enterprise, data, industry

navs.label: Yan ray
navs.when: vertical navigation rail on the left; application feel, command palette, tool families

densities.label: rare
densities.when: ≤5 items per screen, ample white space

densities.label: intense
densities.when: many items, small space, data sense

sectionTypes.label: Hero
sectionTypes.when: intro scene (one of the heroes[] archetypes)
